BL-1302 — A back-one or back-all forward plants a live git_handoff for the same ticket in every earlier mailbox, and the duplicate-chain guard reads each one as a competing chain, so the next role's forward is refused until they drain
What it solves: ## Not the same defect as BL-1299 [2026-08-30 specifier]
Approval context: The defect is measured and the direction is narrow: a non-forwarding inbound cannot start a competing chain, so it should not block one. Worth a human glance only because it slightly loosens a guard that exists to catch a real and expensive failure (one ticket forking into two chains, BL-727), and …
BL-1302 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1302" (or "reject BL-1302 <reason>") to act.
